Name: Quick Flooring Pickup
Author: jyxdong
Description:
[b][u][size=4][font=Georgia]Description[/font][/size][/u][/b]
QuickPickFloor lets you quickly pick up and place flooring and path tiles without chopping them one by one. Click a single tile to act on it instantly, or hold the right mouse button and drag to select a whole area — confirm with Enter or cancel with Esc. Perfect for farm redecorating, since you no longer need to remove tiles individually or carefully re-place them by hand.

[b][u][size=4][font=Georgia]Installation instructions[/font][/size][/u][/b]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.

[b][u][size=4][font=Georgia]Main features[/font][/size][/u][/b]
- Toggle Floor Mode on/off with a configurable keybind (default: Shift+P).
- The mode automatically switches based on what you're holding: if you have a flooring/path item selected, it places that flooring; if you're holding nothing (or anything else), it removes flooring instead. 
- Left-click a single tile to instantly pick up or place flooring/paths with no confirmation
- Hold right-click and drag to select a whole area. Tiles are highlighted red (pickup) or green (placement) while selecting, and gray for tiles that will be skipped (e.g. already-floored ground, or ground with nothing to pick up).
- Press Enter to confirm a selection, or Esc to cancel.
- Picking up flooring leaves furniture, chests, machines, and buildings on top untouched.
- Placement works anywhere visible on screen, not just tiles next to your character (even the area under the buildings!)


[b][u][size=4][font=Georgia]Requirements[/font][/size][/u][/b]
- SMAPI
